author: IzziModo
quote: I'm generally less disappointed in Starfield now than I was at release but it is by no means a good game while quite a few patches have made improvements it has more to do with coming to terms with the fact that the game was always for better or worse going to be Fallout 4 in space. However I can't in good conscious score it as well as Fallout 4 because the primary disappointment for myself as a fan of Bethesda's is the incredibly small number of hand crafted locations about 200 to FO4s 500.
